name: @breadboard/ui-tars-adapter
description: First-party Breadboard-owned adapter around the official Agent TARS browser runtime. Loopback-only, secret-gated, browser-operator only. Breadboard is the sole control plane; this adapter never becomes a second authorization system.
//dependencies: @agent-tars/core@0.3.0 corresponds to bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop @ c2ad42e3eb9b27830db41a3e6f51ca7179d9b168. NOTE: the published @agent-infra/browser (0.2.2) diverged from that SHA's source (0.1.1) — its API is Browser.create({launchOrConnect}) with pptrBrowser/wsEndpoint, not LocalBrowser.launch(). The adapter targets the mutually-compatible PUBLISHED set (core 0.3.0 + browser 0.2.2), isolated behind RuntimeClient. `react` is a transitive peer of @agent-infra/browser (via valtio/react). The real runtime is loaded lazily only when UI_TARS_RUNTIME=agent-tars, so fast unit/CI tests need none of these installed.
